WITH rating_rental_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    f.rating,
    COUNT(r.rental_id) as rental_count
  FROM film f
  JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) as avg_count
  FROM rating_rental_counts
),
above_average_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    rrc.rental_count,
    oa.avg_count
  FROM rating_rental_counts rrc
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE rrc.rental_count > oa.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(rental_count) as average_count,
  AVG(rental_count - avg_count) as average_excess
FROM above_average_ratings;
